statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. BOJ repricing raises Stress, but current evidence does not establish persistent NQ mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; conditional risk is concentrated in post-BOJ repricing and Friday's U.S. data/open/expiration cluster.
headline: BOJ hikes rates; Tail stays low without persistent NQ path evidence
body: BOJ has raised its policy rate to a 31-year high. Asian equities are firmer, Brent is down about 1%, and the U.S. 10-year yield is near 4.94%. Finviz context is fresh but partial and lacks futures/calendar data; live NQ retracement detail is incomplete.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours moved from low Tail to WATCH during the U.S. rally, briefly crossed the block threshold twice, then returned to low Tail after the cash close.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low unless NQ develops persistent extension with shallow or failed retracements. Stress peaks around 13:00-14:30 UTC for U.S. data, cash-open, Bowman and expiration flows.

forecast.analysis: BOJ has raised rates to a 31-year high. Asian equities are firmer and oil/yields are lower; live NQ retracement detail is incomplete, so Tail stays low.
drivers: BOJ hike is observed; live NQ path confirmation is incomplete

forecast.analysis: Post-BOJ repricing can stay whipsaw-prone. Tail rises only if NQ persistently extends, holds an extreme and rejects meaningful retracements.
drivers: Post-BOJ NQ persistence is the Tail trigger

forecast.analysis: If BOJ repricing is absorbed without sustained NQ extension, mixed two-way trade should dominate; lower oil reduces one immediate amplifier.
drivers: Absorption without extension favors mixed trade

forecast.analysis: Pre-Europe Tail stays low if futures rotate rather than hold an extreme; a cross-asset shock raises Stress before it proves a pathological NQ path.
drivers: Pre-Europe rotation would suppress Tail

forecast.analysis: European participation improves signal quality. Tail stays low with normal retracements; shallow pullbacks plus repeated extension would raise it.
drivers: European cross-asset confirmation becomes more useful

forecast.analysis: European cash trade overlaps expiration positioning. WATCH is conditional; deeper retracements or cross-asset conflict would keep the path non-pathological.
drivers: European open and expiration flows raise conditional risk

forecast.analysis: With Europe active, WATCH reflects flow distortion and event proximity. A higher state requires NQ to hold an extreme and repeatedly reject pullbacks.
drivers: Failed NQ retracements would justify escalation

forecast.analysis: Late European morning brings U.S. catalysts closer. Tail stays WATCH unless NQ develops sustained extension with little meaningful mean reversion.
drivers: U.S. event proximity raises Stress

forecast.analysis: Pre-U.S. positioning may become more directional, but the block threshold still requires observed persistent structure rather than anticipated releases.
drivers: Observed persistence, not anticipation, governs Tail

forecast.analysis: The hour before Industrial Production has high event/flow uncertainty. Tail remains below block because future results and reactions are not assumed.
drivers: Industrial Production is approaching

forecast.analysis: Industrial Production at 13:15 UTC and the 13:30 cash open/Bowman remarks form the sharpest checkpoint; escalation needs observed post-event persistence.
drivers: 13:15 data and 13:30 open/Bowman cluster

forecast.analysis: State Employment at 14:00 UTC follows the open. WATCH persists unless NQ becomes one-way with shallow pullbacks and confirming cross-assets.
drivers: 14:00 State Employment follows the cash open

forecast.analysis: After the opening cluster, Tail eases if price discovery turns two-sided; a delayed second directional leg would keep risk higher.
drivers: Post-open retracement depth should clarify the path

forecast.analysis: Midday rotation away from extremes would reduce Tail. Repeated failed pullbacks would prevent the expected decay.
drivers: Midday retracement depth is the key evidence

forecast.analysis: Expiration can keep afternoon Stress elevated, while normal mean reversion would continue pulling Tail lower.
drivers: Expiration can distort afternoon structure

forecast.analysis: Later risk depends on alignment among technology breadth, rates and NQ. Cross-asset conflict or meaningful retracement would suppress Tail.
drivers: Cross-asset alignment determines persistence risk

forecast.analysis: Power-hour expiration flows can re-accelerate or reverse the session. A stronger state requires actual repeated extension, not calendar risk alone.
drivers: Power hour can amplify expiration flows

forecast.analysis: After the cash close, Tail returns to low if the session ends with two-way price discovery; residual headline Stress remains.
drivers: Cash close removes the main expiration concentration

forecast.analysis: Near the weekly futures close, live structure becomes less informative. Tail stays low absent an unresolved late-session directional shock.
drivers: Weekly futures close reduces path information

forecast.analysis: Once futures close for the weekend, intraday mean-reversion failure cannot be observed; headlines mainly affect reopening-gap Stress.
drivers: Weekend closure removes continuous NQ price discovery

forecast.analysis: Weekend closure keeps path-based Tail low. Geopolitical or policy headlines remain reopening inputs rather than observed trend evidence.
drivers: Weekend headlines are reopening-gap inputs

forecast.analysis: With markets closed, Tail stays low and confidence eases. New shocks primarily alter reopening Stress until futures resume.
drivers: No live NQ structure is available during closure

forecast.analysis: Closed-market conditions cap path-based Tail. Any weekend escalation remains gap risk until live futures test mean reversion.
drivers: Gap risk remains conditional until reopening

forecast.analysis: The market remains closed, so Tail stays low. New weekend shocks would first change reopening Stress, then require live path confirmation.
drivers: Tail requires live post-reopen structure
